2928.title: macOS Keychain credential format mismatch
2928.rootCauseOneLine: The credential reader parses an encoded Keychain value as plain JSON and skips the valid file fallback.
2928.proposedFix: Decode strict hexadecimal Keychain values, validate all candidates, and use the credential file after an invalid Keychain candidate.
2928.caveats: The exact BB path was reproduced twice. A live provider account was not used.
